candidates.name: Included Health, Inc.
candidates.description: Both offer navigation services and virtual primary care focused on employers and health plans.
candidates.rationale: Included Health provides virtual primary care and healthcare navigation to employers and health plans, overlapping Teladoc’s virtual-care offering and buyers.

candidates.name: Carbon Health
candidates.description: Both integrate virtual telehealth visits with hybrid primary and urgent care physical clinics.
candidates.rationale: Carbon Health offers virtual telehealth and hybrid primary/urgent care, overlapping Teladoc’s virtual-care offering and serving the same patients and healthcare buyers.

candidates.name: American Well

candidates.name: MDLIVE, Inc.

candidates.name: Babylon Health

candidates.name: Raj Odedra

candidates.name: Hims, Inc.

candidates.rationale: Both provide virtual medical consultations and treatment delivery, with overlapping telehealth use cases for patients seeking remote care.

candidates.name: 98point6 Inc.

candidates.name: Dialogue Technologies Inc.

candidates.name: Doctor Anywhere Pte Ltd

candidates.name: Accolade, Inc.

candidates.rationale: Accolade offers employer-focused virtual care and healthcare navigation, overlapping Teladoc’s virtual-care services and benefits-buyer persona.

candidates.name: Conexa Saúde

candidates.name: OpenLoop Health, Inc.

candidates.name: Crossoverhealth
candidates.description: Both combine virtual care capabilities with employer-sponsored physical primary care clinics.

candidates.name: Modivcare

candidates.name: Access TeleCare, LLC
candidates.description: Both focus on providing specialized, high-acuity telemedicine solutions for hospitals and health systems.
candidates.rationale: Access TeleCare provides clinician-led telemedicine services to hospitals, overlapping Teladoc’s virtual-care platform and healthcare-system buyer needs.
